goal: Roadmap R40: a change that breaks an artifact the kit generated in other repos ships with the list of watched repos that hold one.
changed: sweep.py BOOKS_DIR --artifact NAME lists the watched repos holding a phase spec, a verify skill or a REVIEW.md, read through gh api. --containing keeps files in the old format, --at reads a past day, --public-only names no private repo.
The Authoring a skill playbook has a step that runs it and puts the repos in the PR.
The reliability checklist has a sixth item, generated-artifact-format.
No upgrade PR is owed today: the same sweep without --at finds no watched repo, public or private, still holding a phase spec in the old format.

claims.claim: Replayed against the 0.12.0 spec change, it lists the watched repo that held a phase spec in the old format.
